data.name: Fateemah
data.gender_notes: Fateemah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is exalted or conquers, derived from the Arabic word ‘aftat’, meaning ‘to open or to conquer’. The name Fateemah carries the meaning “Conquering, Exalted One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fateemah usually hope their child will grow to embody conquering, exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the spiritual journey of seeking knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Fateemah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conquering, Exalted One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fateemah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: فاطمة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل فطم، بمعنى منقطع أو منفصل
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاطمة هو اسم علم مؤنث عربي، مشتق من الفعل فطم، والذي يعني الانقطاع أو الانفصال. ويرتبط هذا الاسم بالسيدة فاطمة الزهراء، ابنة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وهي شخصية محترمة في الإسلام. يعتبر اسم فاطمة من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالعفة والطهارة والانقطاع عن الدنيا وارتباطها بالله.

in_urdu.name: فاطمہ
in_urdu.meaning: فاطمہ کا مطلب ہے منقطع یا الگ، ایک خوبصورت اسلامی نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاطمہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے منقطع یا الگ۔ یہ نام حضرت فاطمہ الزہراء ، نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی بیٹی کے نام سے وابستہ ہے۔ اس نام کا اہمیت اسلامی تقویم میں بہت زیادہ ہے، اور یہ پاکدامن، طہارت اور معنوی ترقی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फातिमा
in_hindi.meaning: फातिमा का अर्थ है - अलग या विच्छिन्न, एक सुंदर मुस्लिम नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: फातिमा एक सुंदर और महत्वपूर्ण मुस्लिम नाम है। इसका अर्थ है अलग या विच्छिन्न। यह नाम फातिमा الزهراء के नाम से जुड़ा है, जो पैगंबर मोहम्मद की बेटी थीं। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत अधिक है, और यह पवित्रता, शुद्धता और आध्यात्मिक उन्नति का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: فاطمه
in_pashto.meaning: فاطمه د معنی دا لړۍ: د جلا یا بېل، يوه ښکلې اسلامي نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: فاطمه يو ښکلې او مهمه اسلامي نوم دی. دغه نوم د فاطمه الزهراء په نامه مشهوره ده، چي د پيغمبر محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم د لور نوم دی. دا نوم د پښتنو په کلتور کې ډیر اهمیت لري، او د پاکۍ، طهارت او روحاني پرمختګ نښه ده.

in_english.name: Fateemah
in_english.meaning: A beautiful Muslim name meaning cut off or separated
in_english.long_meaning: Fateemah is a significant Muslim name derived from Arabic roots. It means 'cut off' or 'separated'. This name is associated with Fatimah Al-Zahraa, the daughter of Prophet Muhammad. In Islamic tradition, Fateemah symbolizes piety, purity, and spiritual elevation. The name holds great importance across Muslim cultures, reflecting virtues of modesty and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fateemah holds a significant place in Islamic history and culture as it is the name of the Prophet Muhammad’s (PBUH) beloved and revered daughter. She is remembered for her exceptional devotion, unwavering courage, and unyielding dedication to Islam. As the Prophet’s only surviving daughter, Fateemah (PBUH) is considered a role model for Muslim women and an embodiment of grace, strength, and fortitude.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Fateemah (PBUH) is regarded as the epitome of obedience, love, and sacrifice. Her deep connection with her father, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), serves as a reminder of the importance of familial bonds and the value of maintaining a strong and loving relationship with parents. Till her last moments, Fateemah (PBUH) remained steadfast in her faith and loyalty to the Prophet, offering him her full devotion and companionship even during his later years. Hence, Fateemah’s name is evocative of the spiritual virtues of piety, sacrifice, and deep love for the Prophet of Islam.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Conquering, Exalted One" symbolizes One who is exalted or conquers, derived from the Arabic word ‘aftat’, meaning ‘to open or to conquer’.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fateemah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of conquering, exalted one.
